text:
Type: grey curtains with tie-backs, one pair
Use: dressing a window, dimming light, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: classic, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: heavy woven fabric with a fine texture, matching fabric tie-backs
Colors: dark charcoal grey
Shape: two long panels with a gathered pleated header on a rod, held back by tie-backs into an hourglass drape, deep vertical folds, full and heavy
Feel: cozy, enveloping, elegant, calm
Goes with: white walls, light or dark wood, yellow or blush accents, grey textiles; classic, contemporary or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: BLEKVIVA
product.description: The densely woven curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
